content_text:
I’m preparing for a shoot that has a scene of six people talking around a table. These scenes seem deceptively simple since they’re almost entirely dialogue, but there’s so many angles and eye-lines you need to account for. I’m curious how
a scene like this one from Burn After Reading
was prepared and shot. I know the Coens don’t get full coverage of every scene, but I wonder in a case like this if it’s best to get as many angles as possible and assemble it in the edit.
